summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile strike targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, with Iranian-designed Geran-4/5 drones striking from Orel-Yuzhny and explosive drones hitting a university in Kyiv, a train near Odesa, and residential areas in Kyiv Oblast. Ukraine's Air Force reported shooting down a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo airfield in Rostov Oblast. President Zelensky announced new German air defense packages and appointed Svyatoslav Zaiets as the new Commander of Ukraine's Ground Forces, replacing previous leadership amid ongoing restructuring.
key_points: Russia launched large-scale drone strikes overnight targeting Kyiv, Odesa, and multiple oblasts using Iranian-designed Geran-4/5 drones deployed from Orel-Yuzhny test range, with explosions reported in Vasylkiv and multiple Kyiv districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73402)

Ukrainian Air Force reported destroying a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo airfield in Rostov Oblast according to the General Staff. (Source: @UkraineNow/83851)

President Zelensky announced Ukraine is introducing a two-tier air raid alert system with yellow level for drone threats and red level for missile threats, adjusting curfew and public transport protocols accordingly. (Source: @UkraineNow/83853)

A Shahed drone struck a university in Kyiv during class hours, though all 160 students were in shelter according to Zelensky's statement; Mezhigorye Park cancelled all tours due to security concerns. (Source: @UkraineNow/83846)

An enemy drone struck near an Odesa-Dnipro passenger train, but passengers and crew had been evacuated to a safe distance before impact and the locomotive absorbed the strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/83856)
President Zelensky announced new air defense packages from Germany will arrive this month as the country faces intensified aerial bombardment. (Source: @UkraineNow/83848)

President Zelensky appointed Svyatoslav Zaiets as the new Commander of Ukraine's Ground Forces; Zaiets previously commanded the 20th Army Corps and brings experience from airborne assault forces. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23792)

According to a Two Majors summary, air defense systems destroyed 109 Ukrainian UAVs over Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol regions, Moscow region, Crimea, and the Black Sea in a single day. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive overnight drone and missile strike targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions using Iranian-designed Geran-4/5 drones deployed from Orel-Yuzhny test range. Explosive drones struck a university in Kyiv during class hours, a passenger train route between Odesa and Dnipro, and residential areas in Vasylkiv and Kyiv Oblast. Ukraine's Air Force reported shooting down a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo airfield in Rostov Oblast. President Zelensky announced new German air defense packages, introduced a two-tier alert system, and appointed Svyatoslav Zaiets as Commander of Ground Forces.

points: President Zelensky announced Ukraine will introduce a two-tier air raid alert system, designating yellow level for drone threats and red level for missile threats, with adjustments to public transport operations and curfew protocols during alerts. Under the new system, enterprises and government institutions will be permitted to continue operating during yellow level alerts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83853)

President Zelensky confirmed that a Shahed drone struck one of Kyiv's universities during class hours, though all 160 students present were safely in shelter at the time of impact, according to his official statement. (Source: @UkraineNow/83846)

An enemy drone struck near a passenger train operating on the Odesa-Dnipro route, but the locomotive absorbed the impact after passengers, and railway crews had been evacuated to a safe distance beforehand, ensuring no casualties occurred. (Source: @UkraineNow/83856)

Mezhigorye Park, located at former President Yanukovych's residence, cancelled all tours citing the security situation in Kyiv and the surrounding region, with the Knizhkova Krayina festival postponed to April for the same reason. (Source: @UkraineNow/83852)

Police blocked Shumsky Street in Kyiv's Dnipro district during a special police operation, with officers redirecting pedestrians to sidewalks while the operation continued without official information released to the public. (Source: @UkraineNow/83841)

President Zelensky announced that new air defense packages from Germany will be delivered to Ukraine later this month as the country faces intensified aerial bombardment campaigns from Russian forces. (Source: @UkraineNow/83848)

President Zelensky appointed Svyatoslav Zaiets as the new Commander of Ukraine's Ground Forces; Zaiets previously commanded the 20th Army Corps and brings extensive experience from airborne assault forces and reconnaissance units. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23792)

Russian military forces struck a truck stop near Pavlodar overnight according to Ukrainian intelligence reports, indicating continued strikes against Ukrainian logistics infrastructure in eastern regions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32938)

Russia launched massive overnight drone and missile strikes against Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions using Iranian-designed Geran-4/5 drones deployed from the Orel-Yuzhny test range in Oryol Oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73402)

According to the Two Majors summary, Russian air defense systems destroyed 109 Ukrainian aircraft-type UAVs over Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol regions, Moscow Oblast, Crimea, and the Black Sea within a 12-hour period. An additional four drones were intercepted as they approached Moscow, prompting airspace restrictions at Vnukovo and Domodedovo airports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

In the Taganrog area and seven districts of Rostov Oblast, approximately 20 drones were destroyed overnight according to Governor Slyusar, indicating continued Ukrainian drone strikes against Russian border regions. (Source: @tass_agency/393428)

According to the Two Majors summary, in the Sumy direction, assault groups of the Russian "North" group advanced on 19 sections in the areas of Kiyanitsa and Khoteni, with a total advance of up to 800 meters in 24 hours. In the Shostkinsky district, Russian units continue to advance in the areas of Ulanovo and Tolstodubovo. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

On the Zaporozhye front, the Russian Ministry of Defense reported the liberation of Novopavlovka and Chervona Krynytsia on different flanks of the Orekhovsky direction, with fighting continuing near Orekhovo itself. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

In the Sumy direction, assault groups of the Russian "North" group advanced on 19 sections in the areas of Kiyanitsa and Khoteni, with a total advance of up to 800 meters within 24 hours according to the Two Majors summary. Russian forces continue to advance in the Shostkinsky district in the areas of Ulanovo and Tolstodubovo. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

In the Kharkov direction, heavy fighting continues in Kazachya Lopani and Goptovka with Russian units advancing in the areas of Sliznevo and Dolzhanka near Volchansk while Ukrainian forces transfer reserves, armored vehicles, and UAV units to counter. Advances by Russian assault groups in the western direction are reported in the Velikoburluk area. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

In the Krasnolimansk direction, the situation remains difficult with fighting mainly positional in the Lyman area as Ukrainian forces counterattack from the south and in the area of Drobyshevo. The area of Redkodub-Novoye remains unstable while Russian units attempt to improve positions and tie down Ukrainian Armed Forces reserves. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

In the Dobropol direction, fierce fighting continues with main clashes taking place in the areas of Rubizhne, Annovka, Novonikolaevka, Staroandreevka, and Novoandreevka as Ukrainian Armed Forces counterattack to prevent further expansion of the Russian wedge. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

In the Kherson direction, Russian Armed Forces are striking identified military facilities and enemy depots in Kherson while Ukrainian UAVs attacked a humanitarian convoy of four vehicles near Aleskhi carrying food and medicine. One volunteer was injured and all vehicles and humanitarian cargo were destroyed in the strike. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

Reactive Shahed drones were detected moving from Chernihiv Oblast to Kyiv Oblast, specifically targeting the Vyshgorod district with two drones crossing the border according to monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73409)

Drone tracking reported three drones near Slavutych and new launches heading north toward Chernihiv Oblast from Bryansk Oblast, indicating continued Russian drone incursions through the northern border region. (Source: @eRadarrua/110217)

A drone was spotted near Dymer in the Kyiv region before redirecting toward the Brovary district from Kozelets, demonstrating the multi-directional nature of the overnight aerial assault on the capital region. (Source: @eRadarrua/110226)

Reactive drones were tracked heading toward Brovary and Boryspil in Kyiv Oblast as part of the broader overnight aerial campaign, with additional drones spotted near Irpin, Obukhiv, and Boyarka. (Source: @kpszsu/76038)

Air raid alerts were activated throughout Zhytomyr Oblast due to drone activity targeting Narodychi and Ovruch, with additional tracking showing drones heading toward Kyiv from Poltava Oblast. (Source: @eRadarrua/110211)

An enemy drone struck near a passenger train on the Odesa-Dnipro route, with passengers and railway crews evacuated to a safe distance before impact and the locomotive absorbing the strike according to Ukrainian authorities. (Source: @UkraineNow/83856)

Overnight, Odesa was subjected to a massive attack using strike UAVs and FABs with explosions occurring in several waves, causing damage to infrastructure and residential buildings, power outages, and three casualties including a child according to the Two Majors summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

A reactive drone was detected heading from the Black Sea waters toward Chornomorsk, indicating continued maritime-based launches targeting southern Ukrainian port infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/76047)

In Melitopol, an enemy FPV drone attacked a civilian vehicle, seriously injuring three civilians according to regional authorities, highlighting the persistent threat to civilian transport in occupied territories. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)

A reactive drone was tracked heading from Odesa Oblast toward Vinnytsia Oblast, demonstrating the expanding reach of southern-based drone launches into central Ukrainian regions. (Source: @kpszsu/76015)

Ukraine's Air Force reported shooting down a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo airfield in Rostov Oblast according to the General Staff. (Source: @UkraineNow/83851)

Explosions were confirmed in Vasylkiv from a downed reactive Shahed drone, while another drone was intercepted 31 kilometers from Ternopil after circling, demonstrating the nationwide reach of the aerial assault. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73405)

Russian air defense systems destroyed 109 Ukrainian aircraft-type UAVs across multiple Russian regions including Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol, Moscow Oblast, Crimea, and the Black Sea within a single day. Ukrainian officer Denis Yaroslavsky from the assault force command warned that Russian Armed Forces are planning to target bridges in Kyiv, which could lead to the collapse of the city's infrastructure according to intelligence assessments. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32954)

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level for Kyiv and central Ukrainian regions has escalated dramatically following the overnight deployment of Iranian-designed Geran-4/5 drones from the Orel-Yuzhny test range in multiple coordinated waves. Denis Yaroslavsky's warning about potential Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges indicates credible intelligence regarding high-value infrastructure targeting that could have cascading effects on urban functionality. Ukrainian Air Force successes against Russian aircraft at Yeysk and Millerovo airfields demonstrate improved deep-strike capabilities but may provoke retaliatory escalation. The new two-tier alert system reflects Ukraine's adaptation to sustained drone warfare patterns, while the appointment of Svyatoslav Zaiets as Ground Forces Commander suggests ongoing military restructuring amid mounting operational pressures on multiple fronts.
sections.regional_response: Germany has committed to delivering new air defense packages to Ukraine this month according to President Zelensky's announcement, indicating continued European support despite domestic political challenges. The ongoing Eastern Economic Forum in Vladivostok featured Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov's statements regarding NATO and EU relations, though these diplomatic posturing events appear disconnected from immediate operational developments. Polish public opinion shows 64.4% opposition to transferring Patriot missiles to Ukraine according to IBRiS survey data, with only 21.6% supporting such transfers, signaling potential complications for future military aid coordination. The Russian Sberbank announced restructuring of 3 billion rubles in loans for affected sellers with another 8 billion in progress, reflecting economic adaptation to wartime conditions. Putin's working breakfast meeting with Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto on the forum sidelines indicates ongoing diplomatic engagement with Asian partners.
sections.intelligence_notes: The simultaneous launch of multiple drone waves from different vectors, including Bryansk, Oryol, and Black Sea positions, indicates a sophisticated coordinated attack strategy targeting Ukrainian air defense saturation rather than individual high-value targets. Ukrainian forces demonstrated enhanced deep-strike capability by successfully targeting Russian military aircraft at Yeysk and Millerovo airfields, both located over 200 kilometers from Ukrainian borders. The internal security situation in Kyiv remains volatile following reports of an ongoing shootout between SBU and GUR officers on Shumsky Street in the Berezniaky district, related to the kidnapping of a Russian Volunteer Corps deputy commander. Volunteer Mikhail Puryshev reported being contacted five times by FSB since July 2026 demanding positions of Ukrainian units, with threats against his children living in Russia, indicating intensified Russian intelligence operations targeting Ukrainian volunteers with family connections to Russia.
